title: Greifeinrichtung für eine Handlingsvorrichtung einer Bearbeitungsmaschine

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference discloses a control device for applying vacuum, which implies a vacuum generating device, but does not explicitly state it is electrically operated or located within a housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes vacuum suction cups on a base body forming a suction field, surrounded by a sealing element. This is similar to a suction plate with a carrier and seal, but the term 'suction plate' is not explicitly used, nor is a distinct 'carrier plate' for the seal mentioned.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a gripping device for a handling apparatus of a processing machine, which includes vacuum suction cups on a base body, functioning as a combined grip unit and suction plate for handling workpieces.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.note: (non-English passage at abstract) The reference describes a suction field that can be subjected to negative pressure and a sealing element surrounding it, which implies a suction chamber. However, it does not explicitly detail a 'grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber'.

claims.note: The reference describes a gripping device for a handling apparatus of a processing machine, not specifically a grip unit for a vacuum hand-operated laying device for use with a suction plate.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups on a base body, but does not mention a housing with a grip portion or an electrically operated vacuum generating device.
The reference does not describe a grip portion designed as a hollow body.
The reference does not describe exhaust air being guided through a grip portion to an air outlet.
The reference describes a gripping device for handling workpieces using vacuum suction cups, but it does not mention a sound-damping device arranged in a grip portion.
The reference does not disclose a grip portion being lined with a sound-damping material.
The reference describes a gripping device with vacuum suction cups on a base body, but it does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.
The reference does not disclose a sound-reducing device arranged in a first housing portion or the first housing portion being lined with sound-reducing material.

The reference describes a gripping device for handling workpieces, but does not mention a grip unit with an elongated grip portion between first and second housing portions, nor an air outlet arranged on a second housing portion.
The reference does not disclose an air collection device, such as an air collection screw, arranged upstream of a grip portion for collecting exhaust air.
The reference does not describe air baffles, bent or curved, arranged downstream of a grip portion to guide exhaust air to an air outlet.

The reference does not mention a battery coupling point for an electrical energy storage device or rechargeable battery on the housing, nor air baffles for directing exhaust air away from such a point.
The reference does not mention air baffles for directing exhaust air away from a battery coupling point.
